audit_scope.actual_file: Complete actual statement, proof and remaining-scope remark read.
checks: The PGL semilinear action on the F_p matrix algebra is faithful: scalar matrices detect the field action and the full matrix commutant detects the projective linear kernel.

Induction from the actual normal inner-diagonal-field subgroup of index at most six preserves faithfulness without Maschke or index inversion. Fixed simple exceptions are absorbed into the fixed constant.

A centreless full socle has trivial centralizer in the finite group; conjugation embeds G into the product of factor-automorphism wreath groups. The direct-sum model has dimension at most c log|Soc(G)|.

Maroti Theorem1.1 is applied in all three exact cases. In its alternating-product case, each factor-orbit product of A_m factors is a minimal G-normal subgroup, forcing that alternating type into the fixed finite collection and hence bounding m.

The resulting dimension is O((1+log N)^2); its fourth power supplies the intrinsic model enumeration and the asserted logarithm-to-the-eighth local type bound. No arbitrary imprimitive or cross-characteristic recognition is inferred.
